summary: Built a web application that digitizes management processes for prison staff at the Ministry of Justice.
highlights: Created the React and TypeScript front end of the application
Turned paper-based staff management procedures into forms and dashboards
Managed application state with Zustand and styled the UI with Tailwind CSS
Trained the ministry's IT department staff to use the application
